plans.title: Add a deterministic read-only current-state projection
deliverables: A core current-state contract derived only from validated project, adapter, KB, and research artifacts
Typed relationships carrying source path, content hash, freshness, and authority
No independently stored acceptance, recommendation, or execution state
acceptance_checks: Repeated projection over unchanged inputs emits byte-identical JSON
Changing or removing a pinned source hash causes a fail-closed result rather than stale output
Every displayed relationship names its authoritative source and authority class
The projection performs no writes and cannot promote proposal-only evidence

plans.title: Expose the smallest useful project current command
deliverables: A public `mozak project current PROJECT_ID` route
Bounded sections for goal state, adapter freshness, newest proposal-only research, superseded artifacts, and next owner decision
Explicit labels for latest recorded, latest observed, and accepted state
acceptance_checks: After a newer adapter run exists, the command does not describe an older run as current without a stale warning
For the MOZAK project it reports no ready goals, the compaction finding, and today's agentic-systems research freshness in one response
A project with no adapters or research still returns a valid bounded response
The command output makes no trust transfer or automatic-promotion claim

plans.title: Add provenance-aware browse, resolve, and why navigation
deliverables: Bounded browse over explicitly configured records without filesystem scanning
Resolve output that follows only declared relationships
Why output that explains inclusion, freshness, authority, and blocking conditions
acceptance_checks: Browse never presents ranking as recommendation, acceptance, or truth
Resolve refuses stale hashes and undeclared relationships
Why can explain why today's DAIR run supersedes yesterday's recorded run without accepting either as project knowledge
Default output remains bounded and does not dump note bodies or the full KB

plans.title: Gate future navigation improvements through attributed paired evaluation
deliverables: A failure record that classifies each observed problem as content, schema, or tool behavior
A paired before-and-after CLI evaluation format with fixed project inputs
Owner-review packet that keeps passing proposals non-authoritative
acceptance_checks: The stale-DAIR scenario is reproduced through the installed CLI before a proposed change is evaluated
Only one attributed layer changes per proposal unless dependencies are explicitly justified
A failed or inconclusive comparison produces no implementation or promotion
A passing comparison still requires separate owner approval before implementation
